title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
alt: People with parasols gather in a sunlit park beside the Seine, with boats in the distance.

title: Water Lilies
alt: Pink and white water lilies spread across blue-green water, with soft reflections beneath them.

title: The Great Wave
alt: A towering blue wave curls over long boats, with snow-capped Mount Fuji small in the distance.

title: Moonrise
alt: An orange moon glows through a hazy landscape of trees and a solitary figure.

title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold—Southampton Water
alt: A low golden moon hangs above a hazy blue-green harbor, with faint boats and a dark shoreline.

title: Flower Clouds
alt: A small sailing boat with two figures floats beneath clouds of violet, orange, pink, and blue.

title: Moon Jar
alt: A rounded white Korean porcelain moon jar with a gently uneven outline and a softly glazed surface.

title: Statuette of a Female Figure
maker: Cycladic; probably from the island of Keros · Early Bronze Age, 2600–2400 BCE
alt: A pale marble standing figure with folded arms, a long neck, and a simple oval face with a raised nose.

title: Bowl
maker: Roman; probably Eastern Mediterranean · Early 1st century BCE
alt: A small pale mosaic-glass bowl with a rounded body, short foot, and dark striped rim, on a gray background.

title: Autumn Maples with Poem Slips
alt: A six-panel gold folding screen with red maple trees and hanging poem slips.

title: Thenot Under Fruit Tree
alt: A small black-and-white wood engraving of resting figures under trees, with a round bright light above distant hills.

title: Plum Garden at Kameido
alt: Dark plum-tree branches with white blossoms cross a pink sky, framing a green garden and small distant visitors.

title: Improvisation No. 30 (Cannons)
alt: Black diagonal lines cross shifting red, yellow, blue, and green forms in an abstract painting.

title: Woman in a Garden
alt: A seated woman in a blue dress and flowered hat, surrounded by loosely painted green foliage and pale flowers.

title: The Bewitched Mill
alt: White water streams through a vivid scene of red millwheels, blue buildings, green foliage, and small animals.
